summary: Implemented all five plan phases for task 350: a books-domain record pinning the approvals-stage absent-or-stale detection signature and rulings, a read-only recognizer script emitting a correctly shaped user_decision (enter review now / defer / decline, blocking:false, recommended=defer), a 76-case forgery-probed fixture suite, and the cross-cutting detection rule wired into both books implementation agents. Demonstrated end to end that the recognizer's emitted object reaches verdict=ask_user verbatim through orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh via an isolated --dry-run scratch run, with the honest-red half (status unchanged, nothing written, real repo git status unchanged) confirmed.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase implementation summary covering the detection record, the recognizer, the fixture suite, the agent wiring, and the end-to-end relay demonstration, with two recorded deviations (books extension not loaded in this repo; Batch Gate Deferral applied to the final phase).

decisions_made: Carried forward D1-D5 from the plan unchanged (detection seam, pinned signature, read-only recognizer, extension location, blocking:false/recommended=defer).

A bare 'approve.sh' mention in both agent files' MUST NOT lists tripped check-extension-docs.sh's Rule E; resolved by adding 'approve.sh' to the books extension's manifest.json external_scripts array, the same mechanism the approvals extension's own manifest already uses for the same name.

Confirmed by grep (Phase 4's Scope Hypothesis): books-research-agent.md/books-research-hard-agent.md run lake build/books-tool/the certify driver but never invoke check.sh/full-gate.sh/check-approvals.sh, so wiring only the two implementation agents is correct, not a gap.

Step 5.1's literal 'confirm under .claude/' demonstration could not be observed in this repository because the books extension is not among this repo's loaded extensions (.claude-extensions.json: literature, core, approvals, nix, email, nvim, memory, lean) -- a pre-existing condition, not caused by this task. deploy-headless.sh was still run and its own internal full verify-deploy.sh passed 36/0 for every extension that is loaded.

Step 5.4 discharged against the dispatch file's Batch Gate Deferral directive (scoped narrowing invocations) rather than an independent full verify-deploy.sh sweep, per this being one of several implement-phase dispatches inside one multi-task /orchestrate batch invocation.
